citation: Bhatnagar, Wang, Xiong, Bai - Improved Online Conformal Prediction via Strongly Adaptive Online Learning
task_domain: online conformal prediction; time-series forecasting and classification
horizons: task dependent; not designed around 3/6/12-month maturity
label_availability_assumption: online feedback becomes available through the sequential task; horizon-linked delayed maturity is not the central assumption
shared_information_description: strongly adaptive online learning shares/adapts information across temporal intervals, not by transferring earlier-maturing horizon residuals
flowwatch_gap_threatened: threatens novelty based only on adaptive conformal prediction, temporal shift, or local adaptation
relevance_to_flowwatch: Strong U1 baseline candidate. Does not directly answer whether matured short-horizon residuals should calibrate unresolved long horizons.
verification_note: Title/authors/year verified; exact experimental horizon details should be checked from full paper before final manuscript.

citation: Sun, Yu - Conformal Prediction for Time-series Forecasting with Change Points
task_domain: non-stationary time-series forecasting with change points
horizons: not a FlowWatch-style asynchronous 3/6/12 maturity design
label_availability_assumption: online observations are used to react to or anticipate state changes; not formulated as horizon-dependent maturity
horizon_calibrators_share_information: No explicit maturity-based short-to-long horizon residual transfer
shared_information_description: predicted underlying state is used to improve adaptive conformal calibration
flowwatch_gap_threatened: threatens novelty based only on regime-aware or change-point-aware conformal adaptation
relevance_to_flowwatch: Important RQ1 baseline where assumptions fit. It addresses rapid adaptation to regime changes but not FlowWatch's specific cross-horizon maturity question.
verification_note: NeurIPS 2025 title/authors and coverage-width evaluation verified.

citation: Tu, Giesecke - Online Conformal Prediction for Non-Exchangeable Panel Data
horizons: online panel prediction; not a multi-horizon maturity formulation
label_availability_assumption: when one target unit is predicted, contemporaneous outcomes from related units may already be observed; target feedback is incorporated when revealed
horizon_calibrators_share_information: Yes across peer units, not explicitly across forecast horizons
shared_information_description: history-based similarity weights use observed calibration units; adaptive miscoverage state updates with target feedback
shift_model: temporal dependence; unit heterogeneity; sparse target feedback
coverage_metrics: stepwise and long-run coverage; worst-covered-unit behaviour
flowwatch_gap_threatened: threatens novelty based only on panel structure, non-exchangeability, or incomplete/delayed feedback
relevance_to_flowwatch: Highly relevant because FlowWatch is a panel. However, its information sharing is across units rather than from matured short horizons into unresolved long horizons.
verification_note: Title/authors/year and feedback mechanism verified from abstract.

citation: Vaze - Simultaneous Coverage and Efficiency Guarantee in Online Conformal Prediction
label_availability_assumption: feedback model varies by theoretical setting; one stochastic setting assumes full-score feedback
shared_information_description: optimizes coverage violation and prediction-set efficiency jointly against evolving benchmarks
flowwatch_gap_threatened: threatens novelty based only on jointly optimizing coverage and interval efficiency
relevance_to_flowwatch: Important metric and baseline-design reference. Does not directly solve cross-horizon residual transfer under horizon-dependent maturity.
verification_note: Title/author/year and simultaneous coverage-efficiency objective verified.

citation: Siahkali, Verma, Gupta - Coverage Guarantees for Pseudo-Calibrated Conformal Prediction under Distribution Shift
label_availability_assumption: target labels may be unavailable; unlabeled target inputs and pseudo-labels are used
shared_information_description: information comes from pseudo-labels and target covariates rather than matured residuals at shorter horizons
coverage_metrics: target coverage guarantees / coverage degradation bounds
flowwatch_gap_threatened: threatens novelty based merely on unavailable target labels under distribution shift
relevance_to_flowwatch: Shows that label unavailability under shift is already an active CP problem. It does not study asynchronous multi-horizon residual maturity.

citation: Lade, Sai Krishna J., Kumar - Bias-Corrected Adaptive Conformal Inference for Multi-Horizon Time Series Forecasting
horizons: multiple horizons; exact experimental horizon set to verify from full paper
label_availability_assumption: forecast errors become available according to the multi-step forecasting setup
horizon_calibrators_share_information: Reviewed formulation maintains horizon-specific calibration rather than FlowWatch-style earlier-maturity transfer
shared_information_description: bias estimates and conformal states adapt within the forecasting setup; no explicit matured-short-horizon to unresolved-long-horizon residual transfer in the reviewed formulation
shift_model: mean and compound distribution shifts among evaluated regimes
flowwatch_gap_threatened: closest threat: multi-horizon adaptive conformal calibration with delayed multi-step feedback already exists
relevance_to_flowwatch: Primary direct comparator for U1/RQ3. FlowWatch must show that cross-horizon maturity transfer adds information beyond independent horizon calibration.
verification_note: Title/authors/year and reported Winkler improvement verified; exact per-horizon feedback implementation should be rechecked from full paper during focused literature gate.
